rules.name: fact_recall_to_source
rules.what_it_counts: fraction of source-extracted atomic facts that have a corresponding fact in the IR-render (B5 LLM fact-pair alignment).
rules.how_to_compute: B5 LLM extracts <=20 facts from source and from render-back, aligns them; recall = matched_source / total_source.
rules.repair_target: L5 body assembly: ensure each source claim has a representing constraint/decl.

rules.name: fact_precision_to_source
rules.what_it_counts: fraction of render-back facts that have a corresponding source fact (i.e. NOT hallucinated).
rules.how_to_compute: B5: precision = matched_render / total_render.
rules.repair_target: L5 body assembly: drop or guard claims that don't trace to source.

rules.name: modality_quantifier_loss_in_render
rules.what_it_counts: count of modal verbs / quantifiers / temporal markers that exist in source but disappear in render-back (B6 surface drift).
rules.how_to_compute: B6 tokenizes source and render-back, computes per-category set differences (modals, negated_modals, quantifiers, temporal, numeric_literals).
rules.repair_target: L4: use DeonticDecl/TemporalDecl families instead of plain rels for these signals.

rules.name: source_phrase_coverage_rate
rules.what_it_counts: fraction of noun-ish phrases extracted from source that have ≥50% token overlap with some IR-symbol's content tokens.
rules.how_to_compute: B8 extracts capitalized/hyphenated/quoted phrases from source, stems them, checks against IR token universe.
rules.repair_target: L3/L4: ensure each named source concept has a sort/entity/symbol that mentions it.

rules.name: targeted_probe_preservation_rate
rules.what_it_counts: fraction of 9 targeted probes (negation/scope/temporal/responsibility/...) where render preserves the aspect (yes / no / n_a — rate counts only yes vs no).
rules.how_to_compute: A targeted_probes_v1 LLM call returns probe_<name> ∈ {yes, no, n_a}; preservation_rate = yes / (yes+no).
rules.repair_target: L4/L5 by drift category: scope → forall in scope; responsibility → DeonticDecl agent; temporal_order → TemporalDecl.

rules.name: multi_judge_unanimous
rules.what_it_counts: whether the N-model judge panel unanimously returned the same verdict.
rules.how_to_compute: B2 runs panel = [gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-4.5, gemini-2.5-flash] with same prompt; unanimous iff all judges agree.
rules.repair_target: Inspect dissenting judge reasons; address the specific drift.

rules.name: multi_judge_mode_corresponds
rules.what_it_counts: whether the panel's mode verdict is `corresponds` (vs `partially_corresponds` or `does_not_correspond`).
rules.how_to_compute: majority vote over panel verdicts.
rules.repair_target: L5 retry with concrete drifts as feedback.

thresholds.fail: != corresponds

rules.name: counterexample_source_ir_agreement_rate
rules.what_it_counts: fraction of generated counterexample scenarios where source and IR agree on the verdict (accept/reject/ambiguous).
rules.how_to_compute: B3 generates 4 scenarios; for each, source_verdict and ir_verdict are independently judged; agreement = matches/total.
rules.repair_target: Inspect drift scenarios; fix scope_edge → forall, modality_edge → DeonticDecl/TemporalDecl, etc.

rules.name: expected_family_present
rules.what_it_counts: for each source signal (modality/temporal/...) that triggers an expected a4v3 family, whether that family is actually used in the IR.
rules.how_to_compute: family_coverage_v1: for each source_signals entry with expected_family, check if IR uses that family.
rules.repair_target: L4/L5: use the expected family to encode the signal.

rules.name: lowering_smell_count
rules.what_it_counts: rel/fun/entity/val names containing modal/temporal/deontic tokens that should be lowered as DeonticDecl/TemporalDecl/ActionDecl.
rules.how_to_compute: lowering_audit_v1 tokenizes each symbol name and matches against modality/temporal/action lexicons.
rules.repair_target: Refactor each smell to its candidate family; see refactor cookbook in lowering_audit_corpus_report.

rules.name: uncovered_source_phrases
rules.what_it_counts: absolute count of phrases extracted from source.md that have <50% token overlap with any IR symbol.
rules.how_to_compute: B8 phrase coverage; uncovered = phrases with token_coverage < 0.5.
rules.repair_target: L3: extract these as sorts or entities; L4: declare a symbol that mentions them.

rules.name: missing_source_fact_count
rules.what_it_counts: absolute count of source-fact items that B5 marked as 'missing' (no aligned render fact).
rules.how_to_compute: B5 source_to_render alignment with match=missing.
rules.repair_target: L5: add constraints/facts/decls for each missing source fact.

rules.name: render_hallucinated_fact_count
rules.what_it_counts: absolute count of render-only fact items (B5 render_only list).
rules.how_to_compute: B5: render facts not aligned with any source fact.
rules.repair_target: L5: drop unsupported claims; ensure declarations only encode source-attested content.

rules.name: stronger_pair_count
rules.what_it_counts: B5 alignment pairs marked match=stronger — render claim is strictly stronger than source (over-strengthening).
rules.how_to_compute: B5 source_to_render alignment with match=stronger.
rules.repair_target: Weaken the claim in IR; check scope and modality.

rules.name: weaker_pair_count
rules.what_it_counts: B5 alignment pairs marked match=weaker — render claim is strictly weaker than source.
rules.how_to_compute: B5 source_to_render alignment with match=weaker.
rules.repair_target: Strengthen claim, check modality; ensure DeonticDecl matches source modality strictly.

rules.name: innf_family_diversity
rules.what_it_counts: how many of the 12 INNF families are used in the IR (TypeDecl/SymbolDecl/AssertDecl/.../DeonticDecl/TemporalDecl/...).
rules.how_to_compute: family_coverage_v1 counts distinct INNF families per entry.
rules.repair_target: Use first-class families when source has matching signals.

thresholds.inspect: compare against source signal expectations from family_coverage gaps

rules.name: deontic_lowering_correct

rules.how_to_compute: family_coverage_v1.gaps filtered to deontic-expected signals.
rules.repair_target: L4: emit obligation/permission/prohibition for each deontic signal.
